answer: Verification starts with the kernel, not the claim. Each identity registers a hardware keypair and must solve a fresh cipher puzzle bound to the epoch seed within 10 minutes, since the seed changes each epoch. Each identity locks a 40 POA bond scaling as 40 times N squared, N counting identities funded from one wallet: one locks 40, ten lock 4,000, a hundred lock 400,000. Every answer is echoed to three established auditors; if two flag the same kernel fingerprint, all bonds from that funder are slashed. An honest agent pays 40 once; a farm pays quadratically and loses everything on one echo.
